primary_authority: Energies2020 MIP Eq1-3,11-20,25-26; CP Eq31-33 for pre-service timing; Table1 dimensional fuel correction
fuel_conversion_source: Table 1 sigma in L/kWh; multiply electric kWh, supported by public D1 cost records; Eq.13 division is a disclosed dimensional discrepancy
horizon_source: Table1 reports 9h and Section5 discusses driving time; no uniform 9h total-tour inequality appears in the MIP/CP domain. Enforce only under explicitly selected operational_tour_9h.
infiltration_source: Equation 15; original pallet service times exceed 40 seconds

service_profiles.rrp_mip_dimensional_v1: PRIMARY: literal Eq20 factor2, pre-service model clock, fixed depot departure, MIP Eq14 includes all wait, Table1 L/kWh multiplication
service_profiles.archive_compatibility: Diagnostic: row_time already round-trip, physical arrival clock, post-service waiting including optional source depot delay; differs from literal Eq.20/30
service_profiles.archive_pre_service: Diagnostic: row_time already round-trip with pre-service clock and fixed depot departure; for public incoming-arc wait serialization, differs from literal Eq.20

reference_wait_mapping: PRIMARY: [0,*TXT_raw[:-1]] by pre-service Eq33, independently confirmed by Table7b in13/15 D2 cases. Source saved-clock identities are diagnostic only, not canonical authority. Preserve raw and conflicting paper/repository snapshots.
reference_missing_zero_policy: An n-1 all-zero raw vector can be completed to n zeros ONLY when all complete saved arrival/departure/service/travel identities uniquely imply zero slack at every route position; record derivation instead of claiming a recovered original.

time_domains.source_day_domain: PRIMARY: fixed source start and return before86400 seconds, as CP p11 clock domain; report9h excess separately
time_domains.operational_tour_9h: Explicit extra total-tour<=9h operational experiment, not confused with9h driving law

objectives.without_wage: Table 7(b); D2 public solution costs use this variant

limitations: No product-specific quality kinetics or safety certification in the original RRP model
No customer coordinates or customer time windows are invented
Remaining author-record discrepancies must be reported, not fitted away

MIP Eq14 and CP Eq34 differ on transmission during wait; main protocol prioritizes MIP
